# Ocean Spray Foam

> Family-run seawall stabilization contractor based in Bonita Springs, Florida. Uses certified, eco-friendly polyurethane injection to restore failing seawalls, bulkheads, and retaining walls across Southwest Florida.

Ocean Spray Foam specializes in one problem: failing seawalls in coastal Southwest Florida. Polyurethane resin is injected behind the wall to fill voids, bind the eroded fill, and restore the soil column that supports the wall. Typical projects finish in a day at about half the cost of full replacement, with no demolition, no barges, and no marine equipment. Free on-site assessments across Collier and Lee counties.

## Services

- [Seawall stabilization](https://oceansprayfl.com/services/seawall-stabilization/): Polyurethane injection behind failing seawalls, bulkheads, and retaining walls. Fills voids, binds soil, seals erosion channels, restores structural support. About half the cost of full replacement.

- [Service area overview](https://oceansprayfl.com/service-area/): Bonita Springs, Naples, Estero, Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Sanibel, and Marco Island. Collier and Lee counties.
